translation.title: Polydeoxyribonucleotide Sodium (PDRN) Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for nutritional deficiency of the skin and connective tissue, and for conditions prone to ulcers caused by nutritional deficiency (for example, wounds - to supply nutrition).
translation.usage: Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 1 to 2 times a day, or use it as directed by a doctor.
translation.caution: Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have experienced hypersensitivity to this medicine. If a hypersensitivity reaction to this medicine occurs, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
